description:
Andrew Morgan LLC (AM) is a fast-growing Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). We are currently seeking a Technology Business Management (TBM) Developer to build, maintain, and enhance TBM cost models and reporting solutions for federal clients seeking greater transparency into the cost, consumption, and value of their IT investments.   

 This individual will work closely with Government financial, IT, and portfolio management stakeholders and Andrew Morgan team members to ingest and transform financial and operational data, configure cost allocations aligned to the TBM Taxonomy, and deliver dashboards and analytics that inform budget, planning, and investment decisions.   

 The ideal candidate combines strong technical and data skills with an understanding of IT financial management, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex cost data into clear, decision-ready insights in a fast-moving environment. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 
 Develop, configure, and maintain TBM cost models, including cost pools, IT towers, solutions, and business-unit consumption layers aligned to the TBM Taxonomy and client requirements.   

 Build and maintain data ingestion and transformation processes that bring in general ledger, budget, labor, asset, contract, vendor, cloud billing, and IT service management data from multiple source systems.   

 Design and implement cost allocation rules and drivers that accurately map spend from financial accounts through technology resources to the applications, services, and business units that consume them.   

 Develop dashboards, reports, and analytics that provide stakeholders with visibility into IT spend, unit costs, trends, variances, and consumption, and support budget formulation and execution.   

 Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure model outputs tie to authoritative financial sources and are complete, accurate , and defensible.   

 Support recurring model refresh cycles, including monthly and quarterly data loads, troubleshooting of data and allocation issues, and documentation of changes.   

 Support federal IT portfolio and budget reporting requirements, including alignment of cost data to OMB IT Portfolio and Capital Planning and Investment Control (CPIC) reporting and the TBM Taxonomy.   

 Collaborate with Government stakeholders and SMEs in finance, IT operations, cloud, and portfolio management to gather requirements, map data sources, and refine model logic.   

 Analyze cloud and on-premises infrastructure costs and support FinOps-related analysis, including cost optimization opportunities, showback , and chargeback.   

 Automate repetitive data preparation and reporting tasks using scripting, SQL, or ETL tools to improve efficiency, repeatability, and timeliness.   

 Create and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, model design documents, allocation logic, data-flow diagrams, and standard operating procedures.   

 Ensure deliverables are complete, accurate , professional, timely , and compliant with applicable Government standards, including Section 508 requirements.   

 Support the project team with status updates, issue and risk identification, and contributions to client briefings and deliverables.   

 Model Andrew Morgan's expectations for responsiveness, accountability, collaboration, client service, and solution-oriented problem solving. 

 
 REQUIREMENTS: 

 
 3+ years of experience in TBM, IT financial management , financial systems development, data analytics, or a related technical role.   

 Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.   

 Hands-on experience building or maintaining cost models, financial data models, or analytics solutions that combine data from multiple sources.   

 Working knowledge of the TBM Taxonomy and TBM concepts, including cost pools, towers, solutions, and cost allocation methodologies.   

 Proficiency with SQL and data transformation techniques; experience with ETL tools or scripting languages such as Python is preferred.   

 Experience developing dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or comparable platforms.   

 Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to reconcile data, investigate variances, and explain results clearly.   

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and financial concepts to non-technical stakeholders.   

 Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.   

 Ability to satisfy applicable Government personnel suitability/security requirements and complete required Government privacy and information-security training.   

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

 
 Hands-on experience with Apptio (IBM Apptio, ApptioOne , Cloudability , or Targetprocess ) or another TBM or IT financial management platform.   

 TBM Council certification (e.g., Certified TBM Analyst or Certified TBM Professional) or FinOps Certified Practitioner certification.   

 Experience supporting federal agencies, including familiarity with federal budget formulation and execution, appropriations, and IT portfolio reporting.   

 Experience working with federal financial systems or data sources such as Oracle, SAP, CGI Momentum, or agency general ledger and procurement systems.   

 Experience analyzing cloud billing data from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud and supporting cloud cost optimization.   

 Experience developing Section 508-compliant Federal deliverables and working in high-visibility environments with short-turn deadlines and multiple stakeholders.   

 
 SALARY: 

 Base: $125,000-$140,000

 Salary is commensurate with both location and experience.

 THE AM EMPLOYEE WILL DISPLAY… 

 
 Attention to Detail: Produce high-quality deliverables and outputs that align with contract outcomes.

 Self-Sufficiency: Execute tasks independently, seeking client assistance only after internal resources are exhausted, ensuring requests align with contract goals.

 Teamwork: Collaborate effectively with team members, including AMC resources, subcontractors, and government stakeholders.

 Communication/Engagement: Maintain professional conduct in meetings and written communication, participating actively with cameras on.

 Responsiveness: Stay engaged, communicate promptly, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.

 
 ABOUT ANDREW MORGAN… 

 Andrew Morgan LLC, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Alexandria, VA, is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). We specialize in delivering high-quality consulting services to both federal and commercial clients, offering expertise in Strategy and Management Consulting, Technology & Architecture Services, and Industry & Mission Analytics Solutions. Our distinguished clientele includes the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), the Department of Defense (DoD), and the United Stated Army Corps of Engineers (USACE). We are committed to providing innovative solutions and exceptional service to support our clients' missions and objectives. 

 BENEFITS: 

 
 15 days of Paid Time Off + 11 Paid Federal Holidays

 401K Program (up to 4% employer matching)

 Three Gold Healthcare Options (with 75%-90% employer-paid premiums)

 Flexible Spending Account / Dependent Care Assistance Program

 Employer-Paid Short Term Disability Insurance 

 Employer-Paid Long Term Disability Insurance 

 Employer-Paid Life Insurance 

 Professional Training and Development

 Corporate Team Building Events

 And MORE!

 
 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: 

 Andrew Morgan does not discriminate in employment opportunities, terms and conditions of employment, or practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, gender, religious or political beliefs, national origin or heritage, disability, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any characteristic protected by law. ​
